# Vendored: er-save-manager Nightreign item data

`nr_items.json` (relic, effect and vessel names and properties) comes from
[Hapfel1/er-save-manager](https://github.com/Hapfel1/er-save-manager) at commit
`bde1359ee47b6381b54fcd6bf6b7229b86cd483d` (2026-07-22), path
`src/er_save_manager/games/NR/nr_items.json`.

That is the **last revision released under the MIT License** (see `LICENSE`
next to this file). From commit `5ae4eb5` onward the project moved to a
source-available license that forbids reuse in other projects.

**Do not update this file from newer er-save-manager revisions.** To add new
relics or effects, extend the data from another source (for example the
game's own params) in a separate file, and keep this one as is.
